limitations: No provider requests, production writes, real draft starts or acceptance records.
Modeled rosters and retrospective appearance knowledge are diagnostic, not manager behavior.
Rankings use two earlier completed periods only; later player positions may still reflect current identity records.
Scores and windows are replayed; full provider/game/lineup completeness is not inferred.
No real role/item inventory history is available: item shocks are counterfactual sensitivity only.
Seeds are tie-break scenarios, not independent leagues or confidence samples.
